title: About Us
body:
Beautyinu Skincare

Beautyinu is an Indonesian bodycare brand for glowing, moisturized, and fresh skin. Our range includes body lotions, creams, body wash, soaps, and booster powders — all BPOM certified and cruelty-free.

Our Promise

  • BPOM certified products
  • Cruelty-free formulations
  • Affordable luxury skincare
  • Visible results in 14 days

Based in Surabaya, Indonesia. Shipping to Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

title: FAQ
body:
Frequently Asked Questions

How long until I see results?

Most customers notice visible brightening within 2-4 weeks of consistent use.

Are your products safe for sensitive skin?

Yes, all products are BPOM certified and dermatologically tested. We recommend a patch test for sensitive skin.

Do you ship internationally?

Yes! We ship to Indonesia, Malaysia, and Singapore.

What is the shelf life?

24 months from manufacture date when stored properly.

How do I use the Booster Gold Powder?

Mix 1-2 scoops into your body lotion or body cream before applying. Can also be mixed with body wash.

Shipping Policy

Returns & Refunds

We accept returns within 7 days of delivery for unopened products in original packaging. Contact hello@beautyinu.id to initiate a return.
